title: Care and issue handling mentions
summary: This topic mainly contains ambiguous mentions of care, issue handling, and design preferences, with only a small number of clearly negative fragments.

negative.summary: Negative fragments describe dislike of the car or design, even though some mention issues being handled by dealers or service staff.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mix unclear references to dealers taking care of problems, customer experience comments, and brief statements of personal preference without enough context to classify reliably.

limitations: Most fragments are too short or context-poor to determine sentiment confidently.
The cluster mixes service-resolution wording with personal styling preferences, so it is not a fully coherent single theme.
Some assigned sentiments appear counterintuitive relative to the fragment wording, so this summary follows the supplied labels rather than reclassifying them.
